catalog.method: Plain GET, no headers; body is block-alphabet -> Base64 -> AES-256-CBC (IV zero), then every j0 field (XXTEA + Base64) decrypted
catalog.notes: HONEST LIMIT: SERVER 1/2 vless:// templates carry [rkhost]/[rkkey] placeholders no code in this build replaces; kept verbatim. No live connection tested (all servers PREMIUM, auth uses user login).

files.method: Offline-update blob = same encrypted catalog envelope as the live response (block-alphabet -> Base64 -> AES-256-CBC, then j0 fields). .js accepted by the app with the same blob but NOT registered (generic extension). .ovpn is a plain OpenVPN profile, NOT registered; ovpn_decoder.py is a helper only.
